Avery (CS): Hey team, HelioThera flagged three items on their vendor risk form: embeddings export formats, byok encryption during export, and deletion certificate timing. Need quick bullets to reply.
Marta (Security): Short answers: exports allowed via API on request; BYOK wraps persisted artifacts and we can encrypt export bundles; deletion cert available within 30 days after purge.
Jon (Eng): Export formats: ndjson, csv, protobuf. Exports only created by tenant-initiated jobs or admin-approved tickets.
Avery (CS): Can we add a one-line about residency? HelioThera requires EU-only storage.
Marta (Security): We host tenant data in the tenant region by default. Cross-region replication is opt-in and disabled for EU tenants unless contracted.
Ops Bot: Note: snapshot retention default 45 days; admin-adjustable on enterprise plans.
Avery (CS): Great — I'll draft the reply and attach a deletion-cert template. Marking renewal-risk: watch. :white_check_mark:
